description: The keep-test answers for a batch of facts (BUILD-PLAN F90).

facts.description: The keep verdicts for the facts in the batch, in the order shown.

item.description: The label of the fact, such as #1.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining why a future session would or would not act differently or ask the user again without it, or naming which excluded kind it is.

keep.description: Whether to keep the fact (true) or drop it (false).
